verdict.rationale: New Relic documents some background automation. Its vulnerability-management agent triages CVEs, drafts remediation and can open Jira tickets or GitHub issues that trigger coding agents. Alerts continuously evaluate signals against thresholds or anomalies and route notifications without user intervention, and synthetic monitors simulate user activity. However, the evidence does not show a general way for users to define and schedule their own autonomous agentic automations; 'automated remediation' appears only as a marketing line. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable automation/workflow builder, detail on scheduling and triggers for custom autonomous actions, evidence that automated remediation actually ships, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
